people.name: John
people.line: The Baptist, a prophet who prepared the way for Jesus

translations.web: She, being prompted by her mother, said, “Give me here on a platter the head of John the Baptizer.”
translations.bsb: Prompted by her mother, she said, “Give me here on a platter the head of John the Baptist.”
translations.kjv: And she, being before instructed of her mother, said, Give me here John Baptist's head in a charger.
translations.asv: And she, being put forward by her mother, saith, Give me here on a platter the head of John the Baptist.
